fixed-position stamp: should repeat on every page (Chrome behavior)

Rendering torture test (fictional, no real data)

What to check in the PDF
  1. The small gray 'fixed-position stamp' text appears in the bottom-right of every page (browser behavior; some converters show it only once).
  2. Grid section: 3 equal columns of cards with drop shadows. No card is cut in half by a page break.
  3. The blue-bordered box marked 'do not split' is kept whole on one page.
  4. The 'forced page break' heading starts at the top of a new page.
  5. Section 5: a table cell taller than one page. It should continue onto the next page (not be cut off or squashed).
  6. Unicode line: accented Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic (right to left), emoji. Missing glyphs show as empty boxes - note which.
  7. The 'screen only' line must NOT appear in the PDF. The 'print only' line MUST appear.
  8. The striped box that is 140% wide gets clipped or overflows - note what your tool does (no right answer, but it should not crash).
  9. Wrapping code block wraps. Non-wrapping code block is cut at the edge (expected).
  10. Nested list numbering goes 1, a, i. CSS counters read 'Item 1:', 'Item 2:' ...
  11. Text at 5pt is still readable when zoomed in (it should be real text, not an image - try selecting it).

SCREEN ONLY: if you see this in the PDF, print media styles were not applied.

PRINT ONLY: this line should appear in the PDF.
